# Panasa Technology

> Panasa is a fintech engineering studio that helps regulated fintechs launch, scale, and operate secure payment platforms with AI-native engineering, governance, and 24/7 operations.

## About

Panasa Technology provides end-to-end engineering, operations, and compliance services for fintech companies. With 20+ years of experience, 300+ team members, and billions of transactions managed, Panasa serves issuers, processors, neobanks, and payment platforms across the UK, EU, and APAC.

## Services

- AI Accelerated Fintech Engineering: AI-led fintech engineering, strategy, automation, and platform development
- AI Governance: AI risk management, regulatory alignment (GDPR, EU AI Act, ISO 42001), and governance frameworks
- Intelligent Operations: 24/7 transaction monitoring, fraud detection, dispute handling, and operational dashboards
- AI Powered Legacy Modernisation: Legacy code extraction, system decomposition, refactoring, and cloud modernisation

## Engagement Models

- Engineering Squads: Flexible team extension with payment specialists
- Managed Services: Full operational ownership with SLA-backed performance
- Project-Based: Fixed scope, fixed budget, clear deliverables
- GCC Delivery Model: Build and scale global delivery hubs
